subject: general
question: Whose autobiography is titled ‘And Then One Day: A Memoir’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Naseeruddin Shah.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• 'And Then One Day: A Memoir' is an autobiography of Naseeruddin Shah, an Indian film and stage actor.
 
• 'And ;Then One Day', has the actor recounting his life from childhood to the beginning of his career in Bollywood.
 
• The veteran actor's autobiography joins Waheeda Rehman's biography "Conversations with Waheeda" and Dilip Kumar's autobiography 'Dilip Kumar: The Substance and The Shadow'. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****Anupam Kher **

 
• 'Lessons Life Taught Me Unknowingly' is an autobiography of Anupam Kher.
 
• Anupam Kher was the former chairperson of the Film and Television Institute of India.
 
• He was awarded Padma Shri in 2004 and Padma Bhushan in 2016.

**Kabir Bedi **

 
• Veteran actor Kabir Bedi's memoir was published on April 2021.
 
• It is titled 'Stories I Must Tell: The Emotional Journey of an Actor'.
